purpose: Attempt a controlled Admin-role PR-3.3 smoke cycle using the signed-in Owner session and SCIM provisioning.
reason: SCIM provisioning created a separate provisioned user instead of changing the signed-in user's membership. The active browser session remained Owner.

unexpectedSideEffects.summary: The intended Admin-denial probe POST /api/tenants returned 201 because the signed-in session remained Owner.
unexpectedSideEffects.name: PR-3.3 blocked admin tenant
unexpectedSideEffects.cleanupStatus: Cleanup requires database or Azure/admin access because the API does not expose tenant listing and route tenant scope prevents patching an orphan tenant from the original tenant context.

unexpectedSideEffects.summary: SCIM created a separate provisioned user instead of changing the signed-in member role.

remainingBlockers: Provide real staging smoke identities or tokens for Admin, Compliance Manager, Contributor, Auditor, and Advisor.
Provide database or Azure/admin access to locate and archive the accidental orphan tenant named PR-3.3 blocked admin tenant.
Do not use SCIM to rotate the only active Owner session into lower-privilege roles without an out-of-band restore path.
